Fact: eval_datasets
What to find: Datasets or benchmarks used for evaluation.
Card sections that often contain it: Evaluation, Benchmarks

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Evaluated on reasoning benchmarks across mathematics, programming, instruction following and general logic. Named benchmarks in the table include AIME24, AIME25, HMMT25 and AMO-BENCH. The table also has other benchmarks, which are not listed in this value. A test-time scaling evaluation via DeepConf was run on a few of the benchmarks.
quotes: The model demonstrates outstanding performance across various benchmark evaluations, including mathematics, programming, instruction following, and general logic.
